header: Stream Microsoft Defender XDR events to your storage account
content:
to your storage account
Article • 11/05/2024
Applies to:
Microsoft Defender XDR
Create a Storage account in your tenant.
Sign in to your Azure tenant
, and go to Subscriptions > Your subscription >
Resource Providers > Register to Microsoft.Insights.
Once the storage account is created, you need to define the user who is signing in as a
contributor.
1. Go to Storage Account > Access control (IAM), and then select Add.
2. Verify the user is listed under Role assignments.
７ Note
Try our new APIs using MS Graph security API. Find out more at: Use the
